evidence: Reads a context record via its +0xf10 pointer, uses attribute_record_value_get for base/derived values, and adds several 16-bit values from a context-indexed table before returning the total (decompiled/main/main_0082.c:20420-20443,20468-20516). Callers pass a record and attribute/context indices, then compare or accumulate the returned value (decompiled/main/main_0082.c:18319-18323,19917-19921).

For each of three pointer slots at offsets +0x10, +0x120, and +0x230, reads a target record, obtains its attribute value, and conditionally writes a value and pointer to output slots (decompiled/main/main_0108.c:37463-37525,37527-37535). Its callers feed record-like objects and output slots from attribute-processing paths (decompiled/main/main_0108.c:37424-37428,36497-36501).

Initializes pitch-flight state fields, checks sample counts/indexes, dispatches a selected state object, computes the sample-record address, appends a sample, and integrates state when append fails (decompiled/main/main_0158.c:10924-10940,10956-10976,10997-11018). Both direct callers are named pitch-flight routines (decompiled/main/main_0158.c:11103-11106,11256-11260).

Validates attribute/context indices, checks status and support for attributes 1 and 2, then updates selected byte counters at offsets 0 through 3 in the output record (decompiled/main/main_0033.c:34327-34355,34357-34382). Callers supply boolean flags and context values for this shared helper (decompiled/main/main_0033.c:28027-28030,49406-49410).

Iterates up to 0xd07 entries from the global table at 0x7002288738, tries a sequence of lookup/match operations for each entry, then invokes a registration-like helper with the matched entry and associated values; performs cleanup after exhausting the scan (decompiled/main/main_0169.c:33259-33299,33300-33316). One caller follows a frontend player-stat initialization routine and checks its success before calling this scan (decompiled/main/main_0169.c:33396-33400).
